title: Cosmic Collision
description: A man in an ornate floral suit and a woman in a flowing green dress stand dramatically in an old theater as a powerful beam of light strikes his chest, exploding into sparks and debris. The background shows a shattered movie screen revealing a giant eye in a stormy sky, while the theater is filled with floating film reels, papers, and an audience under a vibrant cosmic nebula ceiling.
prompt: A man in a highly detailed ornate floral suit and a woman in a flowing emerald green Victorian dress stand in an old theater as a powerful beam of light strikes his chest causing an explosion of sparks and debris. Behind them a massive movie screen is shattered revealing a giant eye in a stormy sky. The theater is filled with floating film reels, papers, broken frames and an audience watching from the balcony under a ceiling that opens into a vibrant colorful nebula and galaxy. Dramatic cinematic lighting, surreal atmosphere.
